import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from shift import elapsed

class Shift(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_signed_days_and_fraction(self):
        start = datetime(2026,4,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        end = start + timedelta(days=2,seconds=3,microseconds=250000)
        self.assertEqual(elapsed(start,end),172803.25)
        self.assertEqual(elapsed(end,start),-172803.25)
        self.assertEqual(elapsed(start,start),0.0)
    def test_offset(self):
        a=datetime(2026,4,1,8,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=8)))
        b=datetime(2026,4,1,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        self.assertEqual(elapsed(a,b),0.0)
    def test_naive(self):
        aware=datetime(2026,4,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        naive=datetime(2026,4,1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): elapsed(naive,aware)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): elapsed(aware,naive)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
